title: a literal above 2147483647 is accepted as the argument of a DWORD parameter
note: CMP-012: a literal over the full range of the type MUST be accepted; 4294967295 is a valid DWORD (16#FFFFFFFF) and an untyped literal takes the type of the parameter it is given to; 16#F0F0F0F0 XOR 16#FFFFFFFF = 16#0F0F0F0F
